svg.title: Plate VI — The Envoy: the MCP server and the in-app assistant
svg.desc: Two ways in. Left, the MCP server: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Claude Desktop, VS Code and Cursor fan into one daemon per machine. Right, the in-app assistant: a buerli app with the part in its viewport and the chat panel beside it. Both lead to one request — "Make a flanged bushing: a 60 mm flange with a flat, a 30 mm hub bored through, four bolt holes and a port in its side." — and a pointing hand leads to the result, the flanged bushing, engraved in iso.
